title: Structure-aware Bayesian full waveform inversion via diffusion-regularized Stein variational gradient descent
abstract: arXiv:2610.19187v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Full waveform inversion (FWI) is a powerful tool for high-resolution subsurface model reconstruction, but it remains highly nonlinear and ill-posed, especially when the initial model is inaccurate or the acquired data are noisy and incomplete. Annealed Stein variational gradient descent (ASVGD) provides a particle-based Bayesian framework for FWI by approximating the posterior distribution with an ensemble of velocity models, thereby enabling uncertainty quantification beyond a single deterministic solution. However, conventional ASVGD-FWI commonly relies on simple handcrafted priors, such as Gaussian or smoothing assumptions, which are often insufficient to represent complex geological structures. To address this limitation, we introduce a learned diffusion model (DM) as an implicit regularization mechanism within the ASVGD-FWI framework. translated_title: 基于扩散正则化Stein变分梯度下降的结构感知贝叶斯全波形反演
translated_abstract: 全波形反演（FWI）是高分辨率地下模型重建的强大工具，但它仍具有高度非线性和不适定性，尤其是在初始模型不准确或采集数据含噪且不完整的情况下。退火Stein变分梯度下降（ASVGD）通过用一组速度模型集合来近似后验分布，为FWI提供了一种基于粒子的贝叶斯框架，从而能够在单一确定性解之外实现不确定性量化。然而，传统的ASVGD-FWI通常依赖于简单的手工先验，如高斯或平滑假设，这往往不足以刻画复杂的地质结构。为解决这一局限，我们在ASVGD-FWI框架中引入训练好的扩散模型（DM）作为隐式正则化机制。训练好的扩散模型无需显式计算扩散先验密度，而是作为……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将学习得到的扩散模型作为隐式正则化机制嵌入基于退火Stein变分梯度下降的贝叶斯全波形反演框架，以刻画复杂地质结构先验并增强反演的不确定性量化能力。
